raw.details:
Event Guidelines & Details

  • Registration Deadline: Closes on 9th October 2026 at 11:59 PM (midnight). Ensure you register before the deadline to confirm participation.
  • Dual Registration Required: While registration from Unstop will be considered, participants must also register through the Google Form to complete the process.
  • Registration Fees:

    • Hackathon: 800
    • Ideathon: 500
  • Submission Deadline: Teams must submit their PPT/Idea by 12-Oct-26 to qualify (if your team does not qualify, the fee will be refunded to your original payment method).
  • Out-of-state teams travelling long distances are encouraged to submit their PPTs early.
  • PPT Requirements: Must clearly mention the Problem Statement chosen, Solution Approach, Technology Stack, and Team Details.
  • Shortlist Announcement: Shortlisted teams/PPTs will be declared by 13-Oct-26.
  • Event Dates & Venue:

    • 24-hour Hackathon: 16th–17th October 2026 at BIT Campus, Bamni, Ballarpur.
    • Ideathon Presentation: 17th October 2026 at BIT Campus, Bamni, Ballarpur.

  • Problem Statement
    • Re-Identifying Individual Wild Animals.Identify individual animals, even when the viewing angle, lighting, distance, or image quality changes.
    • Tech for Wildlife Crime Prevention.
      Develop technology-driven solutions to detect, prevent, and combat wildlife crimes such as poaching, unlawful wildlife trade, cyber-based wildlife crime, and more. 
    • Forest Fire Detection and Response.
      Build a system that detects potential forest fires early, identifies their location, and help communicate useful, actionable information for monitoring and response.

      (Note: Participants are requested to bring all the necessary hardware/components required to build and demonstrate their IoT solution.)
  • Registration link (Google form).
    Google Form link :
    https://forms.gle/wnCwiB46e3ZHZNhS7


  • Mandatory Google Form Submission: Your registration will only be considered valid and complete after you fill out the official Google Form.

  • Payment via Google Form Only: All registration payments must be made directly inside the Google Form and not through the Unstop platform.

  • Assistance: If your team requires any assistance, please feel free to reach out to the contact persons below.

  • Aniket Bahuriya: 8530007967

  • Sanjokta: 8788471834

  • S.S. Goje: 9834602964

  • Piyush Gupta: 9607349454
